title: Mohd. Ashfaq Khan @ Ashfaq Khan v. State of U.P. thru. Addl. Chief Secy., Energy Deptt., Lucknow & 3 Others
coram: Rajan Roy & Om Prakash Shukla, JJ.
disposition: Writ petition disposed of; petitioner directed to apply for a fresh connection with indemnity bond/proof of possession under Clause 4.4, to be decided within one week after inspection
headnote: Where an electricity connection is disconnected on the application of a subsequent transferee-owner while an occupant/tenant claiming possession disputes the disconnection as harassment, the occupant may apply for restoration/fresh connection in his own name under Clause 4.4 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 by furnishing an indemnity bond and proof of possession; the licensee may conduct an inspection to verify possession before granting the connection, without prejudice to any civil dispute over title/possession between the parties.

holding_units.code: U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 (Clause 4.4 — new/fresh connection on indemnity bond)
holding_units.clause: 4.4 (connection to an occupant on indemnity bond and proof of possession)
holding_units.topic: An occupant/tenant whose connection was disconnected at the instance of a transferee-owner may seek a fresh connection under Clause 4.4 by furnishing an indemnity bond and proof of possession, subject to licensee inspection and without prejudice to the parties' civil rights
holding_units.question: Can an occupant, whose electricity connection was disconnected upon a transferee-owner's application for permanent disconnection, obtain restoration/a fresh connection in his own name pending a possession dispute?
holding_units.holding: The petitioner was directed to apply for an electricity connection with an indemnity bond and proof of possession under Clause 4.4; the licensee may inspect to verify possession (hearing the transferee-owner in the process), and if there is no legal impediment and possession is proved, the connection shall be granted — without prejudice to either party's rights to pursue separate proceedings regarding possession/title.
holding_units.limiting_facts: The petitioner, claiming to be a tenant/occupant, had his electricity connection disconnected on 7.2.2025 pursuant to a permanent-disconnection application filed by the opposite party no. 4, a subsequent transferee-owner of the premises whose predecessor held the original connection.

principle_tags.application: An occupant/tenant may obtain a fresh electricity connection under Clause 4.4 on furnishing an indemnity bond and proof of possession, even amid a dispute with the property's transferee-owner, subject to licensee verification and without prejudice to civil rights.

not_decided.point: Underlying title/possession dispute between the petitioner (occupant) and opposite party no. 4 (transferee-owner)
not_decided.note: Expressly left open for separate proceedings as may be permissible in law.
